facts.fact: IT-Online reports that seven NTT Data South Africa data centres (Bryanston, Parklands, Cape Town, Umhlanga, Bloemfontein, Gqeberha, East London) were acquired by Open Access Data Centres (OADC) and are leased back to NTT Data for six years, which continues to provide client services from them; as_of is the article date.
